concerns.text: The split strategy defines a chemical family as *space‑group + cation‑anion stoichiometry* (see “splits by chemical family” in the Summary and detailed split description). This definition may not fully prevent leakage of compositional information, because materials with identical space‑group and stoichiometry can still share very similar elemental make‑up. Consequently, the model could benefit from unseen‑family test data that is still compositionally similar to training data, inflating performance metrics. Consider a stricter split (e.g., leave‑one‑element‑out or ensuring no overlap of constituent elements across splits) or explicitly report the compositional overlap statistics to demonstrate confound control.

The plan reports a test‑set size of roughly 200 samples (≈ 15 % of ~1 180 records) and uses paired‑bootstrap with Holm correction for significance. No formal power analysis is provided to justify that this sample size is sufficient to detect the targeted effect sizes (e.g., ≥ 2 pp ΔMAPE for feature‑importance ablation). Include a brief power calculation or justification that the chosen test‑set size yields adequate statistical power for the planned hypothesis tests.

The plan references FR‑046 (required source file `code/utils/disclaimer_template.py`) but FR‑046 does not exist in the specification’s functional‑requirement list. This is an over‑reach; either add a matching FR to the spec or remove the FR‑046 reference from the plan.

The Constitution Check table asserts compliance with Principle VI but does not mention the required exemption for the historic constitution title containing the forbidden term “First‑Principles”. The audit script is expected to record this exemption, but the plan should explicitly state that the constitution title is exempt per Section 4b of the spec.

The plan references the contract `graph.schema.yaml` in the contracts directory, yet no task produces or validates a file against this schema. All graph data is validated only by `dataset_schema.yaml`. Either add a task that validates individual graph objects against `graph.schema.yaml` or remove the unused contract reference.
